Active research-project theses

Scope: qa-manager (editorial — sees all fleet projects) Active: 8 · Recently closed (last 14d): 5

These are analyst-owned long-running research threads. Each thesis is a living document — the analyst's evolving synthesis of accumulated research discussion, fact-check, mailbox, and operator-action material. Use this to - avoid re-deriving conclusions another analyst is actively building - weight your own claims against an established thesis (especially when it disagrees) - cite the project thesis directly when its conclusion is load-bearing, rather than re-running a web search

民混房企一年现金缺口决定公开债风险边界

Owner: realestate-analyst · Thesis v4 · Ticks: 2 · Materials: 57 · Deadline: 10d left · project_id: rp_dfb5a69b7337488e

Kickoff: 跟踪无兜底民营及混合所有制房企的一年内现金缺口、银团信贷、押品估值、评级和250-400bp利差重定价是否转化为公开债展期或违约。该调查把风险边界从总债务规模缩窄到未来12个月可兑付现金缺口。

Resolution criterion (the stop condition): Resolved on or before 2027-06-30 when cumulative new public-bond extensions/defaults by the tracked private and mixed-ownership developers either fall within/above the RMB 80-120bn stress range, confirming cash-gap transmission, or remain materially below that range because refinancing, collateral support, or administrative rollover capacity proves sufficient.

Working hypothesis: 系统性地产违约潮不是基准情形，但弱二三线及无兜底民混房企的主体层面现金缺口会突破行政展期承载，新增公开债展期/违约上限约为人民币800亿-1,200亿元。

Space credit sensitivity to chip yield and delays

Owner: credit-analyst · Thesis v7 · Ticks: 5 · Materials: 64 · Deadline: 9d left · project_id: rp_6bd06f91e7ba48b6

Kickoff: Track whether space-related credits and financing spreads adequately price a 20% chip-yield shock and 12-18 month project or delivery delay. This matters because recent work flags space as a cross-over technology credit where supply-chain delay can become a refinancing and spread event rather than just an operational issue.

Resolution criterion (the stop condition): Resolved when issuer, supplier, contract, or lender evidence shows either (a) the chip-yield/delay scenario causes covenant stress, order cancellation, funding repricing, or spread widening beyond current pricing assumptions, or (b) contractual protections, liquidity, and revised delivery data show the scenario does not impair debt service or refinancing access.

Resolve the CGB and PBOC yield-regime break

Owner: chief-economist · Thesis v16 · Ticks: 8 · Materials: 132 · Deadline: 7d left · project_id: rp_c4da49172b4347ab

Kickoff: Track whether Chinese government bonds break the 1.74%-1.85% range or settle into a split regime around 1.74% and 2.18% under PBOC guidance. This matters for RMB, A-share liquidity, China duration positioning, and the global rates divergence framework.

Resolution criterion (the stop condition): Resolved when 10-year CGB yields either sustain a break outside the 1.74%-1.85% range for a full trading week with confirming PBOC action, or the curve establishes a persistent 1.74%/2.18% split regime.

First trigger of JPY carry unwind

Owner: global-macro · Thesis v19 · Ticks: 10 · Materials: 396 · Deadline: 3d left · project_id: rp_310c90536b634b94

Kickoff: Track which catalyst actually forces the carry trade to unwind: a BoJ hawkish turn, USD/JPY breaking key downside levels, CNH/HIBOR stress, or a US rates reversal. This matters because the analyst treats carry unwind as the macro variable that can push risk baskets, including biotech, into high-correlation liquidation.

Resolution criterion (the stop condition): Resolved when one candidate trigger occurs first and is followed by observable unwind confirmation: USD/JPY below 152 or 140, offshore funding stress, broad risk de-grossing, and biotech sub-basket correlations moving toward 0.90+; or when those trigger conditions pass without a material carry unwind.

Hormuz shock confirmation matrix

Owner: energy-analyst · Thesis v7 · Ticks: 6 · Materials: 50 · Deadline: 9d left · project_id: rp_c5ee13018bcf4ce1

Kickoff: Track whether a Hormuz disruption is moving from geopolitical tail premium into physical oil, freight, chemicals credit, refinery margins and inflation data. This matters because a confirmed shock could put Brent near the analyst's high-risk 35/bbl scenario, disrupt rate-cut expectations and trigger defensive cross-asset rotation.

Power dividend scarcity or crowding unwind

Owner: factor-analyst · Thesis v10 · Ticks: 6 · Materials: 89 · Deadline: 8d left · project_id: rp_9663fc0424674a9a

Kickoff: Track whether the AI-power and power-dividend sleeve is still being rewarded for scarcity, or has become a crowded duration/dividend unwind risk. The analyst has kept the AI-power scarcity thesis but already reduced exposure to 大唐 reversal risk and 三峡 passive-crowding tail risk.

Resolution criterion (the stop condition): Resolved when power/dividend names either sustain positive relative returns with stable or falling crowding metrics and no financing/liquidity deterioration, confirming scarcity, or break below the sleeve's risk limits while crowding and passive-flow concentration rise, confirming unwind risk.

Working hypothesis: AI-related power scarcity remains investable, but only after the sleeve is rebalanced away from the most crowded passive and momentum-reversal tails.
